prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a completely NEW premium identity for 河洛 / HELUO FORGE, an enterprise AI software engineering platform with an ELEPHANT corporate animal.
Concept B: a bold FRONTAL ELEPHANT HEAD, abstracted into a compact near-square architectural glyph. Two wide, confident geometric ears frame a central forehead and a single descending trunk. The silhouette must read instantly as a dignified elephant. The ears are clean angular bracket-like planes, subtly suggesting the code brackets < >. A narrow intentional diamond-shaped negative space between brow and trunk is the AI inference core. Use a calm strong symmetry with careful optical corrections, very few geometric masses, no small facial details. The trunk is strong and straight with a single restrained curved end; no smile, no chubby cartoon, no realistic wrinkles, no ornamental tusks. This symbol should feel like enterprise infrastructure and frontier AI engineering.
Composition: a single horizontal master logo on a clean near-white #F8F9FC presentation canvas, icon at left and a meticulous bilingual wordmark at right. Text EXACTLY "河洛", "HELUO FORGE", and the smaller descriptor "企业级智能研发平台". Contemporary Chinese sans-serif and uppercase architectural English sans-serif. Clear hierarchy and controlled spacing, generous margins.
Colors: dark ultramarine #293CCF for the elephant, deep ink #10192D typography; allow one small cool-cyan #16AEC0 inset only if essential to the inference core.
Flat vector-like brand artwork, strong small-size silhouette, precise smooth edges. No gradients, shadows, glow, 3D, textures, mockups, network nodes, visible circuitry, robot, brain drawing, borders, concept labels, or watermark. One polished logo, not a multi-panel board.
